description: Genesys2 blinky: kintex7 HP differential clock through to a bitstream
why: Was the kintex7 tripwire. fasm2frames used to reject RIOB18 IBUFDS_BANK_GLUE and the IN_DIFF / IN_ONLY features, so the family left the manifest on 2026-08-05. With the k325 chipdb those lines assemble and the bitstream is written, so the guard has tripped and this is a positive test.
